species.name: Fernling
species.personality: Curious and brave; it tests every new path before the rest of the team.
species.desc: A little fox that naps beneath the ferns and wakes at the first rustle.
species.encounterHint: Start in the meadow tall grass, close to camp.

species.name: Emberkin
species.personality: Bold and affectionate; it races ahead, then circles back to check on friends.
species.desc: A warm-pawed fox whose sparks dance when it gets excited.
species.encounterHint: Look where the meadow path meets the sunny eastern grass.

species.name: Brooklet
species.personality: Patient and sociable; it remembers where every smooth pebble came from.
species.desc: A bright river friend that collects smooth stones and shares them with its team.
species.encounterHint: Listen for splashes in Reedfen’s reed-ringed pools.

species.name: Duskwing
species.personality: Quiet until sunset, when it becomes the first to volunteer for a race.
species.desc: A soft-winged night friend that follows the last sunbeams between the trees.
species.encounterHint: Search the high grass in Frostveil Grove, especially at dusk.

species.name: Voltkit
species.personality: Restless and playful; it can never resist chasing a flicker of light.
species.desc: A lightning-fast rabbit that stores the ridge’s dry-air crackle in its tail.
species.encounterHint: Follow the bright sandstone trail into Amber Ridge grass.

species.name: Mushmallow
species.personality: Shy but steadfast; it stays beside a tired teammate until they feel safe.
species.desc: A gentle hedgehog carrying a tiny mushroom garden beneath its cap.
species.encounterHint: Check the damp grass around Reedfen’s quiet water.

species.name: Frostowl
species.personality: Thoughtful and observant; it watches a foe closely before making a move.
species.desc: A watchful owl whose bright feathers hold the cool hush of new snow.
species.encounterHint: Look among Frostveil’s snow-laced trees and tall grass.

species.name: Pebblit
species.personality: Unhurried and loyal; it plants its feet whenever a friend needs backup.
species.desc: A patient tortoise with a sun-warmed crystal shell.
species.encounterHint: Amber Ridge’s warm grass is its favourite place to bask.

species.name: Bramblebuck
species.personality: Gentle and dependable; it makes room for smaller friends behind its antlers.
species.desc: A young meadow deer with leaf antlers and a seed-pod chest.
species.encounterHint: Look for leaf-shaped antlers at the edge of the meadow grass.

species.name: Siltkip
species.personality: Sociable and inquisitive; it pops up wherever a new sound reaches the pond.
species.desc: A web-footed mudskipper with bright side gills and a ribbon tail.
species.encounterHint: Watch the shallow pools in Reedfen; its tail often appears first.

species.name: Sunskitter
species.personality: Fearless and competitive; it turns every open stretch into a starting line.
species.desc: A swift sandstone lizard crowned with sharp turquoise glass scales.
species.encounterHint: Search the rocky grass where the sun reaches Amber Ridge first.

species.name: Hushram
species.personality: Calm and affectionate; it listens first and steps in when the team needs courage.
species.desc: A small mountain goat with curled ice-glass horns and a winter-soft coat.
species.encounterHint: Look for curled blue horns in the sheltered Frostveil grass.

regions.name: Mossvale Meadow
regions.subtitle: Tall grass, old trails, and new friends.
regions.desc: A sunlit meadow where every trail begins.

regions.name: Amber Ridge
regions.subtitle: Golden trails and sparks in the sandstone.
regions.desc: Stone spires, electric friends, and a sleeping guardian.

regions.name: Frostveil Grove
regions.subtitle: Follow the snowflakes to the final shrine.
regions.desc: A quiet snowy grove at the edge of the isles.

regions.name: Reedfen Wetlands
regions.subtitle: Quiet pools, reed paths, and ripples in the grass.
regions.desc: A sheltered wetland where paths wind between pools and tall reeds.

shop.label: Potion
shop.thanks: One potion for the trail. Use it when your companion needs a little help.

shop.label: 5 orbs
shop.thanks: Five fresh capture orbs. There’s always room for one more friend.

spore-guard.name: Spore guard
spore-guard.intro: When the forecast says Brace, your action happens before it braces. After the brace, quick strikes glance off, but an elemental move breaks through. Watch the log for the brace, then answer with an elemental move.

rolling-charge.name: Rolling charge
rolling-charge.intro: It gathers strength, then lands a heavy blow. Watch the line under the log and Guard when the heavy blow is next; a well-timed Guard counters it.

frost-chorus.name: Frost chorus
frost-chorus.intro: Its second elemental volley grows stronger. Switch to a teammate that resists the element before that repeat, or heal once the chorus breaks.

tidal-current.name: Tidal current
tidal-current.intro: The current restores health as it gathers for a heavy blow. An elemental hit during the lull disrupts that recovery; Guard when the line calls out the crash.

intentText.brace: bracing; your next strike after this will be halved
